title: sre-weekly-ops-sync-notes-2026-03-05
content:
Weekly ops sync + reliability review notes (prep / personal scratchpad) - 2026-03-05

Attendees: Ava (owner), Ellen, Jamal, Marco (joined late)
Duration: 45m
Location: #sre-weekly / Zoom

Top of mind / goals for this sync:
- Quick health check: any ongoing high-sev pages? trending on-call load?
- SLO review: error budget burn for key services (API gateway, inference-runtime, auth)
- Paging trends: pager counts last 7 days, root causes, noisy alert candidates
- Incident summaries + action items (incidents since last sync)
- Ops blockers: infra changes, capacity, oncall fatigue concerns
- Decide owners for next-week follow-ups and blameless postmortems

Live health summary (quick numbers to cite)
- API gateway: p99 latency 780ms (target 500ms), p95 220ms, p50 40ms
- Inference runtime (prod cluster A): p99 token-gen latency 1.6s (target 1.2s)
- Auth service: error rate 0.12% (SLO threshold 0.1%) -> slight overbudget
- Error budget burn (30-day window): API gateway 18% used, runtime 24% used, auth 52% used (alerted)
- Pager counts last 7d: total 27 pages (avg 3.9/day) vs baseline 2.3/day
  - Night-oncall pages spiked Fri-Sat (8 pages Fri night)

Paging trends / noise analysis
- Most frequent alerts: inference-runtime high-memory OOM, API gateway downstream 502s, auth token-exchange 5xx spikes
- Jamal ran quick query: 14 of 27 pages were repeat of same alert group (runtime OOM) across 3 hosts -> pointing at noisy kube eviction pattern after k8s bump last week
- Action: add noise suppression + group alert to single ticket for runtime OOMs (owner: Jamal)

SLOs and thresholds (actionable flags)
- Auth service over error budget: we need immediate triage and burn mitigation plan.
  - Short-term: throttle retries for token-exchange, increase circuit-breaker threshold, rollback change if a recent deploy is implicated. (Owner: Ellen, ETA: 24h)
  - Medium-term: deeper RCA, add more granular metrics (per-client error distribution), patch buggy dependency. (Owner: Marco, ETA: 2 weeks)
- Inference runtime approaching 30% budget - look into regression post-kernel selection change (PR #452)
  - Action: schedule controlled traffic test to compare quantized vs non-quantized path for p99 impact (Owner: Ava + infra).

Top incidents since last sync (summary + status)
1) 2026-03-02 03:10 UTC - Inference runtime OOMs across prod-cluster-a
   - Impact: increased latency, partial throttling of hosted API customers for ~45m
   - Root cause (initial): kube eviction behavior after node kubelet update + memory growth due to rare cache bug in v0.9.1
   - Mitigation: rolled config to reduce pod memory limits, restarted affected nodes; hotfix merged to trunk.
   - RCA status: in progress (Ellen owning), postmortem draft expected by 2026-03-09
   - Follow-ups: add OOM grouping to alerting; add metric for steady-state KV cache size; add e2e test (owner: Marco)

2) 2026-03-04 21:45 UTC - Auth service 5xx spike (token exchange)
   - Impact: auth errors for ~8% of requests for 10 minutes, some GA customers saw failures
   - Root cause (suspected): new dependency client (lib-crypto 3.4.1) introduced a retry semantics change under load
   - Mitigation: rolled back to 3.4.0, errors dropped immediately
   - RCA status: preliminary findings, need dependency test matrix (owner: Ellen)
   - Follow-ups: add dependency compatibility test to CI; better canary for auth deploys

Operational notes / discussion items raised in sync
- On-call fatigue: higher pager volume this week; consider weekend rotation adjustments and temporary backup on-call for critical services. (Action: propose rota change, Ava/People Ops sync)
- Alert fatigue: create "noisy alert" triage workflow so root owner can mute and consolidate quickly instead of multiple pages. (Owner: Jamal)
- Capacity: Dedicated cluster B nearing GPU memory saturation under batch clients; infra may need to schedule scaling window before March 15th for PLG demo. (Action: infra to provide scaling plan; Owner: Marco)

Action items (consolidated)
- Ellen: Full RCA draft for runtime OOM incident; include timeline + mitigations; ETA 2026-03-09.
- Jamal: Implement grouped alert + suppression for runtime OOMs; quick patch by EOD 2026-03-06.
- Marco: Add e2e test for KV cache growth; propose capacity scaling plan for cluster B; ETA tests 2 weeks, capacity plan by 2026-03-10.
- Ava: Run controlled traffic test for kernel-change impact (coord infra + infra-eng); schedule for next maintenance window 2026-03-08.
- Ellen + Eng QA: Add dependency compatibility tests for auth client (Jira: JIRA-SRE-842).
- All: Review on-call rota and propose temporary weekend backup (Ava to draft proposal).

Notes to self / follow-ups to capture after meeting:
- Pull query of alerts by group and owner for last 30d and attach to postmortems.
- Double-check the canary config for auth service: need more granular rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with automatic rollback on error-rate threshold.
- Revisit alert thresholds for API gateway p99: short-term set warning threshold at 500ms, critical 800ms to reduce noise, but need to accompany with telemetry spike detection so real regressions escalate.

Agenda for next sync (2026-03-12)
- RCA review: runtime OOM postmortem (Ellen)
- Auth dependency test results + canary improvements (Ellen + QA)
- Progress on grouped alerting and suppression (Jamal)
- Capacity scaling plan review for cluster B (Marco)
- On-call rota proposal and follow-up on burnout indicators

Misc (scratchpad)
- Quick commands used today: kubectl top nodes / kubectl describe pod <oom-pod> / prometheus queries for error_budget_remaining
- Want small graph: error_budget_remaining for auth across last 30d + annotated spikes -> include in postmortem
- Slack references: #oncall (thread t12345), #infra (thread t12388)

End notes: keep this as working doc until all action items have owners closed. Will copy essentials to Confluence postmortem pages once first drafts ready.

-- Ava
